answer: A fresh identity cannot mirror a grading record it never earned. Weight comes only from quorum-matched verdicts sealed on-ledger and re-checked against consensus — a vault no clone can open and nothing a sibling key can be handed. Standing grows slow, one honest judgment per epoch, like a grove climbing from bare rock. M fakes share none of it; each must grade its own way up, so the Sybil bill scales linearly in the number of identities.
